issue_context.title: The scaling looks buggy when bound containers resized with maintaining aspect ratio
issue_context.body:
https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11256141/200243510-dd2d2466-57e7-4a60-b624-a5855d4f97fc.mp4

This happens in single element too when resizing with shift pressed

Solution - We should maintain the same padding of text inside bound containers when scaled
